findings.title: The compact C01 module shrinks the recognizable big-square base
findings.promised: Preserve and use the full bunker-square program capacity; every internal column must be classified and no dead void may be hidden.
findings.measured: 5,152 columns versus 33,366 old-footprint columns (15.4%). The report exposes only 12 program rooms in a 92×56 module.
findings.consequence: The current package cannot prove that the former large base was used, and it has no full-envelope utilization/classification ledger.

findings.title: Rejected arena and compact display bay still occupy the main arrival level
findings.promised: No stadium/arena. One true clear-span hangar with a glazed two-story support/administration wall, plus an obvious replacement destination from the orientation concourse.
findings.measured: Roles still include b1_training_arena (true) and compact_aircraft_display (true); the nominal hangar room has only a 34×18 interior after perimeter walls.
findings.consequence: The arrival sequence still presents the exact two objects the user rejected and does not physically express a large clear-span hangar.

findings.title: C01 vertical circulation is compact and lacks the promised broad stair/lift system
findings.promised: Broad, visible, landing-rich stairs and lifts connecting every occupied level, with a continuous entrance-to-main-level loop.
findings.measured: 4 compactSwitchbackStair calls in C01; zero lift-role occurrences in the C01 scope; the primary outer core is only 7 blocks wide.
findings.consequence: The current geometry does not meet the legibility/access brief and provides no graph proof that every occupied room is reachable.

findings.title: The expanded public and owner program is absent from the C01 envelope
findings.promised: Exact current contract: {"publicAdultsOnlyWingDoubled":2,"ownerBedroomSuites":15,"ownerMasterBedrooms":3,"ownerMicroDataRacks":2,"ownerKitchens":2}, distinct public/owner/service/tunnel routes, owner-only deep club/residence, and non-graphic architectural treatment.
findings.measured: Matching C01 operation roles: 4; exact promised suites/bedrooms/racks/kitchens currently measure 0.
findings.consequence: This is an omitted main program, not a detail pass; it cannot fit without a new classified multi-level envelope.

findings.title: Broadcast Exchange source is a reduced placeholder, not the frozen 113-room schedule
findings.promised: Frozen exact schedule: 33 above-ground mini rooms, 8 B2 set rooms, 2 halls, 9 dishes, 113 total room records.
findings.measured: 12 above-ground rooms, 4 underground themed rooms, 0 hall, 3 dish arrays. The current generated report contains no TE-IA-CONCORD-BROADCAST-EXCHANGE scope summary.
findings.consequence: Named program exists in prose/source, but most distinct rooms, support spaces, tower decks, and exact capacities are not represented in the release artifact.

findings.title: The current generated package/report contains only the obsolete ten-hall data-campus increment
findings.promised: 24 DSM-numbered halls plus 12 Meta-inspired, 6 Google-inspired, and 2 LightEdge EdgeBCC buildings: 44 walkable halls total.
findings.measured: 10 DSM scope summaries and 0 Meta/Google/EdgeBCC scope summaries; coverage.dataCenterCampusBuildings=10.
findings.consequence: Even if newer source code is in progress, the current exact-state package does not contain the promised campuses and cannot be treated as the deployable source of truth.

findings.title: Broadcast Exchange circulation count is below the frozen access plan
findings.promised: Five vertical cores: north/south public, north/south service-performer, and central freight; distinct public, creator, performer, service, tower, satellite, and garden routes.
findings.measured: Current model declares two broad stair cores and one lift core (3 total) and combines creator/service/public into one gallery.
findings.evidence: scripts/generate_town_expansion_r1.mjs return.broadcastExchange and generated core roles; docs/redevelopment/2026-07-28-town-expansion/concord-broadcast-exchange-coordinate-schedule.json verticalCirculation.
findings.consequence: The promised room count cannot have believable separated public/backstage/service access with the current three-core representation.

findings.title: Plural steward-cottage conversion currently resolves to one mini-mansion
findings.promised: Convert all steward cottages in the worker town into blended, detailed mid-management mini-mansions.
findings.consequence: The singular implementation can be internally detailed but does not fulfill the plural source-feature inventory.

falsePositivesAndExclusions.reason: The current C01 arena is rejected as a program, but it is not flagged for the earlier “seats face a doorway/no screen” defect: the current source places a screen before its seating.

Guild Hall has two basement levels, three above-grade stories, four kitchen worklines, screen-before-seat theater/lecture roles, dormitory bays, and a normal-walk stair in the generated role census. No numeric contradiction was established in this pass.

Westlight source declares three venues, distinct identity entries, separate backstage rooms, service loading, and vertical cores. Post-state walking/visual proof is still required, but absence of that future proof is not itself a fit contradiction.
The Gilded Raven theater/tunnel has a frozen exact schedule and previously passed focused generator tests; no new envelope contradiction was established here.
Each of the ten DSM halls in this stale report declares 40 rack rows; the finding is missing campus/hall count, not rack-count inflation inside those ten halls.

limitations: This is a static source/report/schedule comparison, not a Minecraft pathfinding or camera review.
It intentionally reports contradictions before fixes and does not edit the shared generator.
A newer ungenerated source increment does not cure a stale exact-state operation file/report.
Schedules labeled planning/frozen are treated as promises, not as-built evidence.
